## Problem

What measurable problem are we trying to solve?

## Related work

List relevant protocols, papers or implementations. Do not claim novelty before prior-art review.

## Hypothesis

State a falsifiable hypothesis.

## Proposed experiment

Describe the smallest prototype/experiment that could support or reject the hypothesis.

## Baseline

What fair baseline should ZORYQ be compared against?

## Metrics

What should be measured?

## Security / failure modes

How could this design fail, be attacked, centralize the system or increase complexity?
